goal: Populate the PSBT global xpub field when the wallet creates or updates PSBTs
Allow external signers and hardware wallets to verify change outputs and sign multisig transactions
agreement: Substantive support and verified by testing after previous suggestions were addressed (fametrano)
Nonblocking suggestion: bound key derivation along unrelated paths to avoid processing delays (fametrano)
Earlier design and correctness objections on descriptor handling and MuSig were resolved (achow101)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it fixes long-standing interoperability bugs with external signers and hardware wallets
Enables devices like BitBox02 and Trezor to verify change and sign multisig PSBTs directly
Removes the need for coordinator software to manually patch missing xpub fields into PSBTs
